captions.LinkedIn:
Six documentary funding calls have dates between now and February. Two accept US-based producers directly.

Visions du Réel, VdR Pitching: final deadline 15 December 2026 (CHF 30 until 2 November, CHF 40 after). Feature films over 60 minutes in late development, from anywhere.

Sundance, Documentary Film Producers Track: opens 17 November, closes 10 February 2027. Lead producers with at least one documentary short.

The other four are for UK, New Zealand, Australian and European applicants.

I read each funder's own page on 17 October. Every date, with its time zone and a link, is here:
https://www.docudocket.live/blog/documentary-funding-deadlines-november-december-2026/
